# Section descriptor table

Native descriptor table; with the end selector at 0x600463af it fixes each section's loaded range.

**Category:** table · **Address:** `0x600284fc` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

Use these bounds, not 0xFF runs, to place code: section 5 ends 4 KiB before section 6 starts.
